blocks.text: The received headings of the Psalms associate different psalms with figures such as David, Asaph, the sons of Korah, Solomon, Moses, Heman, and Ethan. They can also preserve labels about genre, performance, tunes, instruments, or a narrated setting. Because the meaning and function of these headings remain disputed, they should be read as part of the psalm collection’s received form without assuming that every detail settles how the psalm originated.
